cds.title: Point Park University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF; the file's cover text still reads '2024-2025' but it reports the fall 2025 entering class, fall 2025 enrollment and 2026-27 charges)

ipeds.title: IPEDS via College Navigator: Point Park University profile (student-faculty ratio, setting)

stats.notes: CDS C1 for the fall 2025 entering class (enrolled 593 = 590 full-time + 3 part-time, matching the residency table total). The residency table has 9 applicants and 8 admits of unknown residency, so in-state + out-of-state + international do not sum to the totals. All 59 international applicants were admitted and 26 enrolled. Point Park is test-blind for domestic first-year applicants (C8A: SAT/ACT not used in admission), so no SAT/ACT percentiles are reported. Enrollment 2,498 and intl 108 are the B2 'Total Undergraduates' column (degree-seeking and non-degree; nonresident aliens).

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A (Fall 2027): 'No' - the university does not use SAT or ACT scores in admission; C7 lists standardized test scores as not considered.

cost.notes: CDS G1 for the full 2026-2027 year (first-year and all undergraduates): tuition $40,260 (12-18 credits per term), required fees $2,280, food and housing $14,440 (housing $6,400 + meal plan $8,040), books $1,200. H6: only institutional non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; 113 undergraduate degree-seeking nonresidents received it (average $31,472, total $3,556,282).
